DEPARTMENT OF GENERAL MEDICINE

8TH SEM II - INTERNAL ASSESSMENT EXAMINATION

DECEMBER - 2022 

Date:                       

Time: 10 am to 1 pm

Note: Answer all questions        SET - A                  Max Marks: 60   



10 marks each


1. Enumerate clinical features, criteria of diagnosis and treatment of Rheumatoid arthritis

https://rishikasrirollno20.blogspot.com/2022/07/a-49-year-old-female-with-joint-pains.html


2. Etiology, pathogenesis, clinical features in a patient of chronic liver disease.

https://harikakathumandirollno54.blogspot.com/2022/08/a-25-year-old-male-with-abdominal.html






4 marks each


3. Enteric fever

https://ankitpachipulusurollno13.blogspot.com/2022/06/57-year-old-female-with-diarrhea.html

4. Symptoms and treatment of pulmonary tuberculosis.

https://manisharanga132.blogspot.com/2022/10/80-yr-old-male-with-lung-collapse.html


5. Acute pancreatitis clinical features and management.

https://63konakanchihyndavi.blogspot.com/2021/05/case-discussion-on-pancreatitis-with.html

6. Megaloblastic anemia.

https://khushitulsyanrollno75.blogspot.com/2022/02/18-yr-old-female-with-pancytopenia.html
 

7. Acute glomerulonephritis.

https://kshitijsharmamyrollno192case1.blogspot.com/2022/11/a-65f-with-co-pedal-edema-sob.html


8. Congestive heart failure- clinical features and management 

https://sowmikamarru5.blogspot.com/2021/10/60-years-old-male-presented-with.html?m=1


2 marks each

9. Raynaud’s phenomenon

https://sreelekhatondapuelog.blogspot.com/2022/03/63-year-old-with-pain-in-right-upper.html?m=1


10. Describe 4 anti epileptic drugs

https://manvisharma88.blogspot.com/2022/08/a-70-yr-old-female-with-seizures-and.html

11. HAART regimen



12. Write very briefly on Pemphigus vulgaris


13. Drug therapy for Schizophrenia


14. Management of alcohol withdrawal 


15. anti platelet drugs in stroke prophylaxis

16. Explain the two meningeal signs

https://laharika29.blogspot.com/2022/11/65-year-old-female-with-altered.html
